tests.title: Uncertainty honest (coverage), pooled over all fire regions
tests.case: Fire-region-months 2017-2021, Aqua against converted S-NPP, day/night units with at least 20 Aqua cell-days
tests.criterion: Holdout 2017-2021: share of actual Aqua values inside the predicted 90% intervals (pooled over all fire-region day/night units)
tests.notes: Pooled reading of the criterion [ASSUMPTION]. Not a clean out-of-sample test: phi and kappa were fitted on fit-period months and the NOAA-20 pair overlaps these months on the Aqua side. No widening factor applied (Lead decision). The 50% interval covers less than 50%: the intervals are slightly too narrow in the middle. Known limits in D1-NIGHT and D1-REGIONS-EACH (risk S16).

tests.title: Coverage, fire-region day+night totals (supplementary)
tests.criterion: Holdout 2017-2021: share of actual Aqua values inside the predicted 90% intervals (day+night totals)
tests.notes: Supplementary; the status uses the same range as the locked criterion.

tests.title: Coverage, night units alone, fire regions (supplementary, known limit)
tests.criterion: Holdout 2017-2021: share of actual Aqua values inside the predicted 90% intervals (night units only)
tests.notes: Not part of the locked criterion; reported because night intervals are too narrow. Recorded as a known limit (risk S16).

tests.title: Coverage in each fire region separately (supplementary, stricter reading)
tests.case: Fire regions with at least 30 D/N units, 2017-2021
tests.criterion: Every judged fire region has 90% coverage inside 80% to 97%
tests.threshold: each judged region between 80% and 97% (a stricter reading than the locked criterion)
tests.notes: Not the locked criterion. Shown so the pooled PASS cannot hide that regions are below 80%.

tests.title: Coverage, pooled over all countries (supplementary)

tests.criterion: Holdout 2017-2021: share of actual Aqua values inside the predicted 90% intervals (pooled over country day/night units)
tests.notes: Supplementary: the criterion names fire regions; countries are the T-012 second level.

tests.title: Gaps: outage months have no estimate (estimate level, a part of D2)
tests.case: Every country, fire region and the globe, every month 2002-07 to the latest
tests.criterion: A month without a complete witness has no estimate; a partial witness does not enter an estimate
tests.notes: Estimate-level part only; the verdict part needs T-014 (D2-VERDICTS). Examples of violations, if any, are in the run output.

tests.title: Gaps and insufficiency: verdicts CANNOT_DETERMINE with OUTAGE

tests.title: Gaps and insufficiency
tests.case: Outage months; cells below the data thresholds
tests.criterion: 100% shown as CANNOT_DETERMINE / NO_DETECTED_ACTIVITY; report % of land cells with a determinable verdict
tests.notes: Both halves: D2-ESTIMATES (no estimate without a complete witness) and D2-VERDICTS (CANNOT_DETERMINE with OUTAGE).

tests.title: Generalization (leave one fire region out)
tests.case: 14 GFED fire regions, 2017-2021 Aqua series predicted from S-NPP converted with a calibration fitted without the region
tests.criterion: Our method beats the naive raw merge (lower median absolute log error, day and night) in at least 11 of 14 regions; all regions reported
tests.notes: S-NPP fit 2012-01 to 2016-12 only; a region left out is converted with the global ratio of the fit without it. See docs/validation/T-025-results.md.
